summary_en: We Smile Dental Clinic in Lat Krabang holds a 4.9 rating from 1,429 total reviews, with Dr. Phet specifically noted by patients. The clinic is referenced in 5 Pantip discussions, where users highlight its specialization in orthodontic services.
